attributes.board_name: Maryland Board of Occupational Therapy Practice

rules.accepted_credit_types: At least 16 contact hours on OT principles and procedures; at most 8 through OT role-related activities. Pre-approved: AOTA, MOTA, AOTA-approved providers, NBCOT; others may be Board-reviewed. The Board's 2026 reference guide lists activities and per-year caps (workshops/conferences, academic courses at 4 contact hours per credit, fellowship, specialty certification, physical agent modality training, and others).
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed less than 1 year before renewal: exempt for the first renewal period.
rules.carryover: Not allowed without written consent of the Board.
rules.alternatives: Maintaining current NBCOT certification fulfils the requirement (0 contact hours needed on the renewal form).
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; keep documents 4 years after renewal (physical agent modality records for the whole career); the Board may audit at any time, and audit documentation must include the Board's Continuing Competency Requirement Compliance Report.
rules.legal_basis: COMAR 10.46.04.03–.05; Md. Code, Health Occ. Title 10
rules.notes: 2-year staggered licenses expiring June 30: even-numbered years for those first licensed in an even year, odd-numbered years for odd. Renewal deadline 5/31 postmark, grace 6/1–6/16, late fee to 6/30. Fees (2026 form): OT $254 + $26 MHCC fee, OTA $200. Extensions on request with documentation and a completion plan.
